intent.verbatim: untrusted content the scout reads must never become instructions — the constitution has to name that boundary and the scout seat has to honor it
intent.decoded: The constitution declares an explicit untrusted-input / tool-authority boundary, and the scout role exists as the seat that ingests untrusted content as data, never as instructions (Phase-1a, GAPS #1).

contract.goal: Canon encodes the trust-boundary principle and a scout seat that cuts one leg of the lethal trifecta.

check.expect: exit 0: the constitution names the untrusted-input boundary
exit 0: the scout seat is defined in canon roles

contract.out-of-scope: Sandboxing enforcement at runtime; this gates the canonical doctrine + seat.
contract.regression-surface: Deleting the principle or the scout seat must turn this RED (safety floor).
